veinrebirth.cmd.after_apply_hint: §7New chunks take effect at once; rebuild existing chunks with §e/veinrebirth refresh 4 clean§7.
veinrebirth.cmd.defaults.done: §a[VeinRebirth] §fAll ores restored to vanilla defaults and saved.
veinrebirth.cmd.list.truncated: §7...%d more not shown; filter with §e/veinrebirth list <keyword>§7, or browse with the search box in the in-game config screen.
veinrebirth.cmd.preset.note.refresh: §7After applying, rebuild existing chunks with §e/veinrebirth refresh 4 clean§7.
veinrebirth.cmd.preset.note.scale: §7Presets scale from factory defaults, so applying the same one twice gives the same result; disabled ores are untouched.
veinrebirth.cmd.preset.vanilla_note: §7Note: the Vanilla preset means factory reset, so modded ores go back to 'not managed' as well.
veinrebirth.cmd.refresh.clean_all_hint: §7Note: 'clean all' also cleared modded ores not managed by this mod, and those blocks will not be rebuilt. To clear only this mod's leftovers use §e/veinrebirth refresh <radius> clean
veinrebirth.cmd.refresh.hint: §7Note: this command only adds / rebuilds ores in already-generated chunks; terrain is never regenerated.
veinrebirth.cmd.refresh.mode.all: (clearing every ore block in range, including unmanaged modded ores)
veinrebirth.cmd.refresh.no_dimension: §c[VeinRebirth] Cannot determine which dimension to refresh.
veinrebirth.cmd.refresh.start: §e[VeinRebirth] §fRefreshing ores in §e%s§f within a radius of %d chunks%s...
veinrebirth.cmd.scan.added: §a[VeinRebirth] §fDetected §e%d §fnew modded ores (§e%d §fin total). Written to the config file, not managed by default.
veinrebirth.cmd.scan.added_hint: §7Tip: enable the ores you want to manage in the config screen, or run §e/veinrebirth list §7to see them all.
veinrebirth.cmd.scan.disabled: §7Note: detect_modded_ores = false in the config file, so detection is off and this scan had no effect.
veinrebirth.cmd.scan.start: §e[VeinRebirth] §fScanning the block registry and tags for ores added by other mods...
veinrebirth.cmd.selftest.fail: §c[VeinRebirth] Self-test failed §c%d§f/%d, see the log for details
veinrebirth.cmd.set.unmanage_hint: §7Management disabled, but blocks already generated in the world will not vanish - clear them with §e/veinrebirth refresh <radius> clean§7.
veinrebirth.cmd.share.copy_hover: §7Click to copy the full share code (%d chars)
veinrebirth.cmd.share.encode_failed: §c[VeinRebirth] Failed to create a share code: %s
veinrebirth.cmd.share.file_failed: §7(Failed to write the share file; click-to-copy above still works)

veinrebirth.cmd.share.long_hint: §7The code is long and would be cut off by chat (vanilla limit: 256 chars); use click-to-copy above or the file below.

veinrebirth.cmd.share.other_hint2: §7or run §e/veinrebirth share import <code>§7. After dropping the file into their config/, §e/veinrebirth share import file§7 also works.

veinrebirth.cmd.share.truncated_hint: §7Long share codes get cut off by chat. Use §e/veinrebirth share import file§7 instead, or paste it in the config screen.
